name: ffmpeg
scope: MP4 major brand, title, two tracks, 2x2 video dimensions
family_note: C and C++ call sites share libavformat; the MP4 box parser is in the MOV demuxer.

name: libmediainfo
input_api: MediaInfo::Open(local filename); MediaInfo::Get for container, tracks, title and dimensions
scope: MPEG-4 container, title, AVC video and AAC audio, 2x2 video dimensions
family_note: C and native C++ call sites share MediaInfoLib MPEG-4 parser and ZenLib utility library.

name: gstreamer
scope: MP4 title, video/audio streams and 2x2 video dimensions
family_note: C and C++ call sites share the pinned isomp4/qtdemux plugin.

name: mpv
scope: MP4 demuxer, title and H.264/AAC track codecs
family_note: C and C++ call sites share libmpv, which links the FFmpeg package already listed directly.

name: vlc
scope: MP4 title, video/audio tracks and one-second duration
family_note: C and C++ call sites share libVLC and its bundled MP4 demuxer; exact plugin selection during this run was not independently traced.

name: mp4v2
scope: two MP4 tracks and 2x2 video dimensions
family_note: C and C++ call sites share MP4v2 native parser.

name: gpac
scope: two ISO media tracks, 2x2 video dimensions and duration
family_note: C and C++ call sites share the same gpac native MP4 parser. GPAC MP4Box is a CLI alias within the gpac package, not another package row.

name: bento4
scope: MP4 major brand, two audio/video tracks and one-second duration
family_note: C and C++ call sites share Bento4 AP4 core and C binding; C++ adapter compiles the C binding call site as C++.

name: libquicktime
input_api: quicktime_open(local MP4 filename, 1, 0); quicktime_video_tracks; quicktime_audio_tracks; quicktime_video_width/height
scope: MP4 video/audio track counts and 2x2 video dimensions from parsed atoms
family_note: C and C++ adapters call the same pinned libquicktime C API. Codec decode plugins are not required for the container result.

name: libextractor
input_api: EXTRACTOR_plugin_add("qt"); EXTRACTOR_extract(local MP4 filename, callback) returns format-specific metadata
scope: QT/MP4 plugin parsed MIME type, title, duration and 2x2 video dimensions
family: GNU libextractor native QT/MP4 metadata parser
family_note: C and C++ adapters call the same libextractor qt plugin; its exact installed native plugin hash is pinned.

name: taglib
scope: MP4 title metadata and one-second duration
family_note: C binding delegates to the same TagLib C++ MP4 parser used by the C++ adapter.

name: opencv
scope: MP4 video dimensions, frame count and frame rate from FFmpeg-backed VideoCapture
family: OpenCV VideoCapture wrapper over FFmpeg MOV/MP4 demuxer
family_note: The pinned libopencv_videoio dylib links the pinned FFmpeg libavformat and libavcodec libraries; this is a distinct C++ package API over the FFmpeg parser family.

name: libmp4tag
license_evidence: https://sourceforge.net/projects/libmp4tag/ and LICENSE.txt in pinned source release
documentation: https://libmp4tag.sourceforge.io/ (GettingTags and Initializing in pinned release wiki)
input_api: mp4tag_open(local MP4 filename); mp4tag_parse; mp4tag_get_tag_by_name; mp4tag_duration
scope: MP4 title metadata and 1128 ms duration
family: libmp4tag native MP4 atom and tag parser
family_note: C and C++ adapters call the same published C API and native parser.

name: exiv2
license_evidence: Pinned upstream COPYING in v0.28.9 source and Homebrew license field
input_api: Exiv2::ImageFactory::open(local MP4 filename); Image::readMetadata(); XmpData::findKey for QuickTime/MP4 fields
scope: MP4 major brand and video dimensions from parsed QuickTime XMP metadata
family_note: Exiv2 has a native QuickTimeVideo reader in src/quicktimevideo.cpp; this is not the FFmpeg or TagLib parser family.

name: avcpp
input_api: av::FormatContext::openInput(local MP4 filename); findStreamInfo; inputFormat; stream(index)
scope: MP4 demuxer and one video plus one audio stream
family: AvCpp API over FFmpeg MOV/MP4 demuxer
family_note: Distinct published C++ package/API built against the pinned FFmpeg 9.0.2 libraries; shares the already recorded FFmpeg parser engine.

name: ireader-media-server
input_api: mov_reader_create(mov_file_buffer(), local FILE*); mov_reader_getinfo callbacks; mov_reader_getduration
scope: One video and one audio track, 2x2 video dimensions and 1000 ms duration from valid MP4
family: ireader libmov native ISO BMFF/MOV reader
family_note: C and C++ adapters call the same tagged libmov C parser and upstream FILE callback adapter; counted as one underlying parser family.

name: shiguredo-mp4-rs
scope: Two parsed MP4 tracks (one video, one audio) and one-second video duration
family: shiguredo/mp4-rs Rust ISO BMFF demuxer through its published C API
family_note: The C and C++ adapters link the same tagged Rust static library and call its published C API; one underlying parser family.
